title: It's come a LONG way!
author: BSwayzeYo
selftext:
I'm only a couple of weeks away from releasing on Steam. It's been a long time coming and it's going to be a huge relief to finally get this game in a place where people can play it!

Fishing Nooks has taught me so much about ai game dev and I have 3 other projects in the works as well. I don't care if people call my game slop. I know that it is not slop and it is crafted with incredible care, attention, and passion. Cheers fellow ai game devs! Show me your projects!

  
I've built this using a harnessed Claude Opus 5.5.
